configurePresets.name: uwp-x64
configurePresets.description: Configures the Eden UWP frontend and Direct3D 12 renderer for Xbox Dev Mode. Dynarmic uses W^X and Virtual*FromApp in the Store CRT AppContainer. Run from tools/xbox/build-env.bat so CMake and Ninja use the selected UWP SDK and Store CRT (see docs/xbox/uwp_build.md).

buildPresets.name: uwp-x64
buildPresets.description: Build the Eden UWP Xbox app. Use --target eden-uwp for the installable frontend.
